string-array.name: motivations
string-array.item: “Success is not final; failure is not fatal: It is the courage to continue that counts.”\n– Winston S. Churchill
“The road to success and the road to failure are almost exactly the same.”\n– Colin R. Davis
“Success usually comes to those who are too busy to be looking for it.”\n– Henry David Thoreau
“Opportunities don’t happen. You create them.”\n– Chris Grosser
“Don’t be afraid to give up the good to go for the great.”\n– John D. Rockefeller
“I find that the harder I work, the more luck I seem to have.”\n– Thomas Jefferson
“There are two types of people who will tell you that you cannot make a difference in this world: those who are afraid to try and those who are afraid you will succeed.”\n– Ray Goforth
“Successful people do what unsuccessful people are not willing to do. Don’t wish it were easier; wish you were better.”\n– Jim Rohn
“Never give in except to convictions of honor and good sense.”\n– Winston Churchill
“Stop chasing the money and start chasing the passion.”\n– Tony Hsieh

Nothing in the world can take the place of Persistence. Talent will not; nothing is more common than unsuccessful men with talent. Genius will not; unrewarded genius is almost a proverb. Education will not; the world is full of educated derelicts. The slogan ‘Press On’ has solved and always will solve the problems of the human race.”\n– Calvin Coolidge
“There are three ways to ultimate success: The first way is to be kind. The second way is to be kind. The third way is to be kind.”\n– Mister Rogers
“Success is peace of mind, which is a direct result of self-satisfaction in knowing you made the effort to become the best of which you are capable.”\n– John Wooden
“I never dreamed about success. I worked for it.”\n– Estée Lauder\
“Success is getting what you want, happiness is wanting what you get.”\n– W. P. Kinsella\
“Success is walking from failure to failure with no loss of enthusiasm.”\n– Winston Churchill\
“I owe my success to having listened respectfully to the very best advice, and then going away and doing the exact opposite.”\n– G. K. Chesterton

“Would you like me to give you a formula for success? It’s quite simple, really: Double your rate of failure. You are thinking of failure as the enemy of success. But it isn’t at all. You can be discouraged by failure or you can learn from it, so go ahead and make mistakes. Make all you can. Because remember that’s where you will find success.”\n– Thomas J. Watson\
“There are no secrets to success. It is the result of preparation, hard work, and learning from failure.”\n– Colin Powell
“Success seems to be connected with action. Successful people keep moving. They make mistakes, but they don’t quit.”\n– Conrad Hilton
“If you really want to do something, you’ll find a way. If you don’t, you’ll find an excuse.”\n– Jim Rohn
“I cannot give you the formula for success, but I can give you the formula for failure – It is: Try to please everybody.”\n– Herbert Bayard Swope
“Success is not the key to happiness. Happiness is the key to success. If you love what you are doing, you will be successful.”\n– Albert Schweitzer
“Success isn’t just about what you accomplish in your life; it’s about what you inspire others to do.”\n– Unknown
“Some people dream of success while others wake up and work.”\n- Unknown
“The difference between who you are and who you want to be is what you do.”\n- Unknown
“In order to succeed, your desire for success should be greater than your fear of failure.”\n- Bill Cosby
“In order to succeed, we must first believe that we can.”\n- Nikos Kazantzakis
“Dreams don’t work unless you do.”\n- John C. Maxwell
“Go the extra mile. It’s never crowded there.”\n- Dr. Wayne D. Dyer
“Keep your face always toward the sunshine – and shadows will fall behind you.”\n- Walt Whitman
“What defines us is how well we rise after falling.”\n- Lionel from Maid in Manhattan Movie
“Make each day your masterpiece.”\n- John Wooden
“Wherever you go, go with all your heart”\n- Confucius
“We can do anything we want to if we stick to it long enough.”\n- Helen Keller
“Many of life’s failures are people who did not realize how close they were to success when they gave up.”\n- Thomas Edison
“Don’t be distracted by criticism. Remember–the only taste of success some people get is to take a bite out of you.”\n- Zig Ziglar
“The secret of success is to do the common thing uncommonly well.”\n- John D. Rockefeller Jr.
“You know you are on the road to success if you would do your job, and not be paid for it.”\n– Oprah Winfrey

“I never did anything worth doing by accident, nor did any of my inventions come indirectly through accident, except the phonograph. No, when I have fully decided that a result is worth getting, I go about it, and make trial after trial, until it comes.”\n– Thomas Edison
“I failed my way to success.”\n– Thomas Edison
“There is a powerful driving force inside every human being that, once unleashed, can make any vision, dream, or desire a reality.”\n– Anthony Robbins
“The secret to success is to know something nobody else knows.”\n– Aristotle Onassis
“I never dreamed about success, I worked for it.”\n– Estee Lauder
“The only place where success comes before work is in the dictionary.”\n– Vince Lombardi
“You get what you give.”\n– Jennifer Lopez
“Your life only gets better when you get better.”\n– Brian Tracy
“Happiness is not by chance, but by choice.”\n– Jim Rohn
“Be the change that you wish to see in the world.”\n– Mahatma Gandhi
“If I cannot do great things, I can do small things in a great way.”\n– Martin Luther King Jr.
“We generate fears while we sit. We overcome them by action.”\n– Dr. Henry Link
“Today’s accomplishments were yesterday’s impossibilities.”\n– Robert H. Schuller
“The bad news is time flies. The good news is you’re the pilot.”\n– Michael Altshuler
“Never limit yourself because of others’ limited imagination; never limit others because of your own limited imagination.”\n– Mae Jemison
“Let us make our future now, and let us make our dreams tomorrow’s reality.”\n– Malala Yousafzai
“Just one small positive thought in the morning can change your whole day.”\n– Dalai Lama
“Love your family, work super hard, live your passion.”\n– Gary Vaynerchuk
“Don’t let someone else’s opinion of you become your reality”\n– Les Brown
“If you’re not positive energy, you’re negative energy.”\n– Mark Cuban
“I am not a product of my circumstances. I am a product of my decisions.”\n– Stephen R. Covey
“The best revenge is massive success.”\n– Frank Sinatra
“What’s on the other side of fear? Nothing.”\n– Jamie Foxx
“Quitters never win. Winners never quit!”\n– Dr. Irene C. Kassorla
“It’s not your salary that makes you rich, it’s your spending habits.”\n– Charles A. Jaffe
“If there is no wind, row.”\n– Latin Proverb
“It’s never too late for a new beginning in your life.”\n– Joyce Meyers
“If opportunity doesn’t knock, build a door.”\n– Milton Berle
“Action is the foundational key to all success.”\n– Pablo Picasso
“I never dreamt of success. I worked for it.”\n– Estee Lauder
“A goal is a dream with a deadline.”\n– Napoleon Hill
“You could rattle the stars,” she whispered. “You could do anything, if only you dared. And deep down, you know it, too. That’s what scares you most.”\n– Sarah J. Maas
“It is only when we take chances, when our lives improve. The initial and the most difficult risk that we need to take is to become honest.”\n– Walter Anderson

“The adventure of life is to learn. The purpose of life is to grow. The nature of life is to change. The challenge of life is to overcome. The essence of life is to care. The opportunity of life is to serve. The secret of life is to dare. The spice of life is to befriend. The beauty of life is to give.”\n– William Arthur Ward
“When you know your worth, no one can make you feel worthless.”\n– Unknown
“If you’ve never eaten while crying you don’t know what life tastes like.”\n– Johann Wolfgang von Goethe
“If you judge people, you have no time to love them.”\n– Mother Teresa
“Once you do know what the question actually is, you’ll know what the answer means.”\n– Douglas Adams
“The two most important days in your life are the day you’re born and the day you find out why.”\n– Mark Twain
“Nothing ever goes away until it teaches us what we need to know.”\n– Pema Chodron
‘We can see through others only when we can see through ourselves.”\n– Bruce Lee
“You don’t get paid for the hour. You get paid for the value you bring to the hour.”\n– Jim Rohn

“Be an Encourager: When you encourage others, you boost their self-esteem, enhance their self-confidence, make them work harder, lift their spirits and make them successful in their endeavors. Encouragement goes straight to the heart and is always available. Be an encourager. Always.” \n– Roy T. Bennett”
“Remember, you have been criticizing yourself for years and it hasn’t worked. Try approving of yourself and see what happens.”\n– Louise L Hay
“Work hard and don’t give up hope. Be open to criticism and keep learning. Surround yourself with happy, warm and genuine people.”\n– Tena Desae

“Stay true to yourself, yet always be open to learn. Work hard, and never give up on your dreams, even when nobody else believes they can come true but you. These are not cliches but real tools you need no matter what you do in life to stay focused on your path.”\n– Phillip Sweet
“You can control two things: your work ethic and your attitude about anything.”\n– Ali Krieger
“Success isn’t always about greatness. It’s about consistency. Consistent hard work leads to success. Greatness will come.”\n– Dwayne Johnson

“One, remember to look up at the stars and not down at your feet. Two, never give up work. Work gives you meaning and purpose and life is empty without it. Three, if you are lucky enough to find love, remember it is there and don’t throw it away.”\n– Stephen Hawking

“Some women choose to follow men, and some women choose to follow their dreams. If you’re wondering which way to go, remember that your career will never wake up and tell you that it doesn’t love you anymore.”\n– Lady Gaga

“Read, read, read. Read everything – trash, classics, good and bad, and see how they do it. Just like a carpenter who works as an apprentice and studies the master. Read! You’ll absorb it. Then write. If it’s good, you’ll find out. If it’s not, throw it out of the window.”\n– William Faulkner
“The best way to get started is to quit talking and begin doing.”\n– Walt Disney
“Leaders never use the word failure. They look upon setbacks as learning experiences.”\n– Brian Tracy
“There are no limits to what you can accomplish, except the limits you place on your own thinking.”\n– Brian Tracy
“Someone is sitting in the shade today because someone planted a tree a long time ago.”\n– Warren Buffet
“The pessimist sees difficulty in every opportunity. The optimist sees opportunity in every difficulty.”\n– Winston Churchill
“You learn more from failure than from success. Don’t let it stop you. Failure builds character.”\n– Unknown
“If you are working on something that you really care about, you don’t have to be pushed. The vision pulls you.”\n– Steve Jobs
“Entrepreneurs are great at dealing with uncertainty and also very good at minimizing risk. That’s the classic entrepreneur.”\n– Mohnish Pabrai
“The man who has confidence in himself gains the confidence of others.”\n– Hasidic Proverb
“What you lack in talent can be made up with desire, hustle and giving 110% all the time.”\n– Don Zimmer
“Fake it until you make it! Act as if you had all the confidence you require until it becomes your reality.”\n– Brian Tracy
“I think goals should never be easy, they should force you to work, even if they are uncomfortable at the time.”\n– Michael Phelps
“Leaders think and talk about the solutions. Followers think and talk about the problems.”\n– Brian Tracy
“Don’t let yesterday take up too much of today.”\n– Will Rogers
“Experience is a hard teacher because she gives the test first, the lesson afterwards.”\n– Vernon Sanders Law
“To know how much there is to know is the beginning of learning to live.”\n– Dorothy West
“Goal setting is the secret to a compelling future.”\n– Tony Robbins
“Whether you think you can or think you can’t, you’re right.”\n– Henry Ford
“Security is mostly a superstition. Life is either a daring adventure or nothing.”\n– Helen Keller
“Creativity is intelligence having fun.”\n– Albert Einstein
“Knowing is not enough; we must apply. Wishing is not enough; we must do.”\n– Johann Wolfgang Von Goethe
“Develop an ‘attitude of gratitude.’ Say thank you to everyone you meet for everything you do.”\n– Brian Tracy
“To see what is right and not do is a lack of courage.”\n– Confucius

“Don’t say you don’t have enough time. You have exactly the same number of hours per day that were given to Helen Keller, Pasteur, Michelangelo, Mother Teresa, Leonardo Da Vinci, Thomas Jefferson, and Albert Einstein.”\n– H. Jackson Brown Jr.
“Hard work beats talent when talent doesn’t work hard.”\n– Tim Notke
“If everything seems to be under control, you’re not going fast enough.”\n– Mario Andretti
“Opportunity is missed by most people because it is dressed in overalls and looks like work.”\n– Thomas Edison
“The only difference between ordinary and extraordinary is that little extra.”\n– Jimmy Johnson
“The best way to appreciate your job is to imagine yourself without one.”\n– Oscar Wilde
“Unsuccessful people make their decisions based on their current situations. Successful people make their decisions based on where they want to be.”\n– Benjamin Hardy
“Never stop doing your best just because someone doesn’t give you credit.”\n– Kamari aka Lyrikal

“Work hard for what you want because it won’t come to you without a fight. You have to be strong and courageous and know that you can do anything you put your mind to. If somebody puts you down or criticizes you, just keep on believing in yourself and turn it into something positive.”\n– Leah LaBelle
“Work hard, be kind, and amazing things will happen.”\n– Conan O’Brien
“Go as far as you can see; when you get there, you’ll be able to see further.”\n– Thomas Carlyle
“Your talent determines what you can do. Motivation determines how much you’re willing to do. Your attitude determines how well you do it.”\n– Lou Holtz
“The individual who says it is not possible should move out of the way of those doing it.”\n– Tricia Cunningham

“I learned this, at least, by my experiment; that if one advances confidently in the direction of his dreams, and endeavors to live the life which he has imagined, he will meet with a success unexpected in common hours.”\n– Henry David Thoreau
“When someone tells me ‘no,’ it doesn’t mean I can’t do it, it simply means I can’t do it with them.”\n– Karen E. Quinones Miller
“Build your own dreams or someone else will hire you to build theirs.”\n– Farrah Gray
“A year from now you may wish you had started today.”\n– Karen Lamb
“Light tomorrow with today.”\n– Elizabeth Barrett Browning
“Someday is not a day of the week.”\n– Janet Dailey
“Don’t count the days, make the days count.”\n– Muhammad Ali
“Believe you can and you’re halfway there.”\n– Theodore Roosevelt
“The only way to do great work is to love what you do. If you haven’t found it yet, keep looking. Don’t settle.”\n– Steve Jobs
“Even if you’re on the right track, you’ll get run over if you just sit there.”\n– Will Rogers
“Nothing can stop the man with the right mental attitude from achieving his goal. Nothing on earth can help the man with the wrong attitude.”\n– Thomas Jefferson
“The more I want to get something done the less I call it work.”\n– Richard Bach
“Success is the sum of small efforts repeated day in and day out.”\n– Robert Collier
“If everything seems under control, you’re not going fast enough.”\n– Mario Andretti
“Your imagination is your preview of life’s coming attractions.”\n– Albert Einstein
“Try not. Do, or do not. There is no try.”\n– Yoda
“The true meaning of life is to plant trees under whose shade you do not expect to sit.”\n– Nelson Henderson
“I would rather die of passion than of boredom.”\n– Emile Zola
“Very often a change of self is needed more than a change of scene.”\n– Arthur Christopher Benson
“If you don’t design your own life plan, chances are you’ll fall into someone else’s plan and guess what they have planned for you? Not much.”\n– Jim Rohn
“Develop success from failures. Discouragement and failure are two of the surest stepping stones to success.”\n– Dale Carnegie
“Failure is the condiment that gives success its flavor.”\n– Truman Capote
“It takes courage to grow up and become who you really are.”\n– E.E. Cummings
“What we fear of doing most is usually what we most need to do.”\n– Ralph Waldo Emerson
“It is better to fail in originality than to succeed in imitation.”\n– Herman Melville
“It’s not what you say out of your mouth that determines your life, it’s what you whisper to yourself that has the most power.”\n– Robert T. Kiyosaki
“Success only comes to those who dare to attempt.”\n– Mallika Tripathi
“People rarely succeed unless they have fun in what they are doing.”\n– Dale Carnegie
“We must be willing to let go of the life we planned so as to have the life that is waiting for us.”\n– Joseph Campbell
“Success is liking yourself, liking what you do, and liking how you do it.”\n– Maya Angelou
“Coming together is a beginning, keeping together is progress, working together is success.”\n– Henry Ford
“Don’t aim for success if you want it, just do what you love and believe in and it will come naturally.”\n– David Frost
“The size of your success is measured by the strength of your desire, the size of your dream, and how you handle disappointment along the way.”\n– Robert Kiyosaki
“The question isn’t who is going to let me, it’s who is going to stop me.”\n– Ayn Rand
“Success is a state of mind. If you want success, start thinking of yourself as a success.”\n– Joyce Brothers
“The elevator to success is out of order. You’ll have to use the stairs, one step at a time.”\n– Joe Girard
“Be a positive energy trampoline – absorb what you need and rebound more back.”\n– Dave Carolan
“People often say that motivation doesn’t last. Well, neither does bathing – that’s why we recommend it daily.”\n– Zig Ziglar
“Work until your bank account looks like a phone number.”\n– Unknown
“I am so clever that sometimes I don’t understand a single word of what I am saying.”\n– Oscar Wilde
“People say nothing is impossible, but I do nothing every day.”\n– Winnie the Pooh
“Life is like a sewer… what you get out of it depends on what you put into it.”\n– Tom Lehrer
“I always wanted to be somebody, but now I realise I should have been more specific.”\n– Lily Tomlin
“Always be careful when you follow the masses. Sometimes the m is silent.”\n– Unknown
“Never let anyone treat you like you’re regular glue. You’re glitter glue.”\n– Unknown
“If you fall – I’ll be there.”\n– Floor
“When Plan “A” doesn’t work, don’t worry, you still have 25 more letters to go through.”\n– Unknown
“If you think you’re too small to make a difference, try sleeping with a mosquito.”\n– Dalai Lama
“If at first you don’t succeed, then skydiving isn’t for you.”\n– Steven Wright
“A diamond is merely a lump of coal that did well under pressure.”\n– Unknown
“I find television very educational. Every time someone turns it on, I go in the other room and read a book.’\n– Groucho Marx
“Opportunity does not knock, it presents itself when you beat down the door.”\n– Kyle Chandler
“I have not failed. I’ve just found 10,000 ways that won’t work.”\n– Thomas A. Edison
“Women challenge the status quo because we are never it.”\n– Cindy Gallop
“We don’t just sit around and wait for other people. We just make, and we do.”\n– Arlan Hamilton
“Think like a queen. A queen is not afraid to fail. Failure is another stepping stone to greatness.”\n– Oprah Winfrey
“The strongest actions for a woman is to love herself, be herself and shine amongst those who never believed she could.”\n– Unknown
“Whenever you see a successful woman, look out for three men who are going out of their way to try to block her.”\n– Yulia Tymoshenko

“Some women choose to follow men, and some choose to follow their dreams. If you’re wondering which way to go, remember that your career will never wake up and tell you that it doesn’t love you anymore.”\n– Lady Gaga
“The thing women have yet to learn is nobody gives you power. You just take it.”\n– Roseanne Barr
“No woman wants to be in submission to a man who isn’t in submission to God!”\n– T D Jakes
“A witty woman is a treasure; a witty beauty is a power.”\n– George Meredith
“When a woman becomes her own best friend life is easier.”\n– Diane Von Furstenberg
“If you want something said, ask a man; if you want something done, ask a woman.”\n– Margaret Thatcher
“We need women at all levels, including the top, to change the dynamic, reshape the conversation, to make sure women’s voices are heard and heeded, not overlooked and ignored.”\n– Sheryl Sandberg
“It took me quite a long time to develop a voice, and now that I have it, I am not going to be silent.”\n– Madeleine Albright
“Women must learn to play the game as men do.”\n– Eleanor Roosevelt
“I swear, by my life and my love of it, that I will never live for the sake of another man, nor ask another man to live for mine.”\n– Ayn Rand
“He who conquers himself is the mightiest warrior.”\n– Confucius
“Try not to become a man of success, but rather become a man of value.”\n– Albert Einstein
“One man with courage makes a majority.”\n– Andrew Jackson
“One secret of success in life is for a man to be ready for his opportunity when it comes.”\n– Benjamin Disraeli
“A man who has committed a mistake and doesn’t correct it is committing another mistake.”\n– Confucius Kongzi
“The successful man will profit from his mistakes and try again in a different way.” \n– Dale Carnegie
“A successful man is one who can lay a firm foundation with the bricks others have thrown at him.” \n– David Brinkley
“He is a wise man who does not grieve for the things which he has not, but rejoices for those which he has.” \n– Epictetus
“Talent wins games, but teamwork and intelligence win championships.” \n– Michael Jordan
“Individual commitment to a group effort—that is what makes a teamwork, a company work, a society work, a civilization work.” \n– Vince Lombardi

“Teamwork is the ability to work together toward a common vision. The ability to direct individual accomplishments toward organizational objectives. It is the fuel that allows common people to attain uncommon results.” \n– Andrew Carnegie
“Coming together is a beginning. Keeping together is progress. Working together is success.” — Henry Ford
“Alone we can do so little, together we can do so much.” \n– Helen Keller
“Remember, teamwork begins by building trust. And the only way to do that is to overcome our need for invulnerability.” \n– Patrick Lencioni
“You can get everything in life you want if you will just help enough other people get what they want.” \n– Zig Ziglar
“Inspiration does exist, but it must find you working.” \n– Pablo Picasso
“Don’t settle for average. Bring your best to the moment. Then, whether it fails or succeeds, at least you know you gave all you had.” \n– Angela Bassett
“Show up, show up, show up, and after a while the muse shows up, too.” \n– Isabel Allende
“Don’t bunt. Aim out of the ballpark. Aim for the company of immortals.” \n– David Ogilvy
“I have stood on a mountain of no’s for one yes.” \n– Barbara Elaine Smith
“If you believe something needs to exist, if it’s something you want to use yourself, don’t let anyone ever stop you from doing it.” \n– Tobias Lütke
“The miracle is not that we do this work, but that we are happy to do it.” \n– Mother Teresa
“Never give up on a dream just because of the time it will take to accomplish it. The time will pass anyway.” \n– Earl Nightingale
“If you work on something a little bit every day, you end up with something that is massive.” \n– Kenneth Goldsmith
“The big secret in life is that there is no secret. Whatever your goal, you can get there if you’re willing to work.” \n– Oprah Winfrey
“If you cannot do great things, do small things in a great way.” \n– Napoleon Hill
“Never allow a person to tell you no who doesn’t have the power to say yes.” \n– Eleanor Roosevelt
“At any given moment you have the power to say: this is not how the story is going to end.” \n– Unknown
“Amateurs sit around and wait for inspiration. The rest of us just get up and go to work.” \n– Stephen King

“Your work is going to fill a large part of your life, and the only way to be truly satisfied is to do what you believe is great work. And the only way to do great work is to love what you do. If you haven’t found it yet, keep looking. Don’t settle. As with all matters of the heart, you’ll know when you find it.” \n– Steve Jobs
“Nothing will work unless you do.” \n– Maya Angelou
“Never regret a day in your life. Good days bring you happiness and bad days give you experience.” \n– Unknown
“Either you run the day, or the day runs you.” \n– Jim Rohn
“Only I can change my life. No one can do it for me.” \n– Carol Burnett
“Life is 10% what happens to you and 90% how you react to it.” \n– Charles R. Swindoll
“Act as if what you do makes a difference. It does.” \n– William James
“When the pain of an obstacle is too great, challenge yourself to be stronger.” \n– Will Rogers
“Even if you’re on the right track, you’ll get run over if you just sit there.” \n– Will Rogers
“Very little is needed to make a happy life; it is all within yourself, in your way of thinking.” \n– Marcus Aurelius
“Life is either a daring adventure or nothing at all.” \n– Helen Keller
“The woman who follows the crowd will usually go no further than the crowd. The woman who walks alone is likely to find herself in places no one has been before.” \n– Albert Einstein
“Life’s like a movie, write your own ending. Keep believing, keep pretending.” \n– Jim Hensen
“The same boiling water that softens the potato hardens the egg. It’s what you’re made of. Not the circumstances.” \n– Unknown
“If we have the attitude that it’s going to be a great day it usually is.” \n– Catherine Pulsifier
“You can either experience the pain of discipline or the pain of regret. The choice is yours.” – Unknown
“Impossible is just an opinion.” \n– Paulo Coelho
“Your passion is waiting for your courage to catch up.” \n– Isabelle Lafleche
“Magic is believing in yourself. If you can make that happen, you can make anything happen.” \n– Johann Wolfgang Von Goethe
“If something is important enough, even if the odds are stacked against you, you should still do it.” \n– Elon Musk
“Hold the vision, trust the process.” \n– Unknown
“Don’t be afraid to give up the good to go for the great.” \n– John D. Rockefeller
“People who wonder if the glass is half empty or full miss the point. The glass is refillable.” \n– Unknown
“The first step toward success is taken when you refuse to be a captive of the environment in which you first find yourself.”- Mark Caine
“When I dare to be powerful, to use my strength in the service of my vision, then it becomes less and less important whether I am afraid.” \n– Audre Lorde
“Whenever you find yourself on the side of the majority, it is time to pause and reflect.” \n– Mark Twain
“There is no traffic jam along the extra mile.” \n– Roger Staubach
“If you genuinely want something, don’t wait for it–teach yourself to be impatient.” \n– Gurbaksh Chahal
“If you want to make a permanent change, stop focusing on the size of your problems and start focusing on the size of you!” \n– T. Harv Eker
“If you are not willing to risk the usual, you will have to settle for the ordinary.”- Jim Rohn
“The ones who are crazy enough to think they can change the world, are the ones that do.”- Anonymous
“Do one thing every day that scares you.” \n– Anonymous
“All progress takes place outside the comfort zone.” \n– Michael John Bobak

“People who succeed have momentum. The more they succeed, the more they want to succeed, and the more they find a way to succeed. Similarly, when someone is failing, the tendency is to get on a downward spiral that can even become a self-fulfilling prophecy.” \n– Tony Robbins
“Don’t let the fear of losing be greater than the excitement of winning.” \n– Robert Kiyosaki
“If you really look closely, most overnight successes took a long time.” \n– Steve Jobs

“The real test is not whether you avoid this failure, because you won’t. It’s whether you let it harden or shame you into inaction, or whether you learn from it; whether you choose to persevere.” \n– Barack Obama
“The only limit to our realization of tomorrow will be our doubts of today.” \n– Franklin D. Roosevelt
“Character cannot be developed in ease and quiet. Only through experience of trial and suffering can the soul be strengthened, ambition inspired, and success achieved.” \n– Helen Keller
“The successful warrior is the average man, with laser-like focus.” \n– Bruce Lee

“You can’t connect the dots looking forward; you can only connect them looking backwards. So you have to trust that the dots will somehow connect in your future. You have to trust in something–your gut, destiny, life, karma, whatever. This approach has never let me down, and it has made all the difference in my life.” \n– Steve Jobs
“Two roads diverged in a wood and I took the one less traveled by, and that made all the difference.” \n– Robert Frost
“The number one reason people fail in life is because they listen to their friends, family, and neighbors.” \n– Napoleon Hill

“The reason most people never reach their goals is that they don’t define them, or ever seriously consider them as believable or achievable. Winners can tell you where they are going, what they plan to do along the way, and who will be sharing the adventure with them.” \n– Denis Waitley
“In my experience, there is only one motivation, and that is desire. No reasons or principle contain it or stand against it.” \n– Jane Smiley
“No one is to blame for your future situation but yourself. If you want to be successful, then become “Successful.”- Jaymin Shah
“Things may come to those who wait, but only the things left by those who hustle.”- Abraham Lincoln

“I now tried a new hypothesis: It was possible that I was more in charge of my happiness than I was allowing myself to be.” \n– Michelle Obama
“In a gentle way, you can shake the world.” \n– Mahatma Gandhi

Keep your eyes on the stars, and your feet on the ground.” \n– Theodore Roosevelt

“When you stop chasing the wrong things, you give the right things a chance to catch you.” \n– Lolly Daskal

“No masterpiece was ever created by a lazy artist.” \n– Anonymous
“Happiness is a butterfly, which when pursued, is always beyond your grasp, but which, if you will sit down quietly, may alight upon you.” \n– Nathaniel Hawthorne
“If you can’t explain it simply, you don’t understand it well enough.” \n– Albert Einstein
“Oh yes, the past can hurt. But the way I see it, you can either run from it or learn from it.” \n– The Lion King

“It’s a new dawn, it’s a new day, it’s a life for me and I’m feeling good.” \n– Feeling Good, Michael Buble
“Today is where your book begins, the rest is still unwritten.” \n– Unwritten, Natasha Bedingfield
“A million dreams for the world we’re gonna make’ – The Greatest Showman

“I could build a castle out of all the bricks they threw at me” \n– New Romantics, Taylor Swift
“Cause the grass is greener under me bright as technicolor, I can tell that you can see” \n– Sorry Not Sorry, Demi Lovato

“Money is only a tool. It will take you wherever you wish, but it will not replace you as the driver.” \n– Jen Sincero

“You’re already a financial trader. You might not think of it in just this way, but if you work for a living, you’re trading your time for money. Frankly, it’s just about the worst trade you can make. Why? You can always get more money, but you can’t get more time.” \n– Tony Robbins

“You can only become truly accomplished at something you love. Don’t make money your goal. Instead, pursue the things you love doing and then do them so well that people can’t take their eyes off of you.”- Maya Angelou
“Formal education will make you a living; self-education will make you a fortune.” \n– Jim Rohn
“Time is what we want most and what we use worst.” \n– William Penn
“It’s not about having enough time, it’s about making enough time.” \n– Rachael Bermingham
“Better three hours too soon than a minute too late.” \n– William Shakespeare
“The trouble is, you think you have time.” \n– Buddha
“The greatest gift you could give someone is your time. Because when you give your time, you are giving a portion of your life you can’t get back.” \n– Unknown
“Punctuality is not just limited to arriving at a place at the right time, it is also about taking actions at the right time.” \n– Amit Kalantri
“Time always exposes what you mean to someone.” \n– Unknown
“After all this time? Always.” \n– J.K. Rowling
“You can’t let your failures define you. You have to let your failures teach you.” \n– Barack Obama

“And the day came when the risk to remain tight in a bud was more painful than the risk it took to blossom.” \n– Anaïs Nin
“The standard you walk past is the standard you accept.” \n– David Hurley
“I’ve searched all the parks in all the cities and found no statues of committees.” \n– Gilbert K. Chesterton
“Success is stumbling from failure to failure with no loss of enthusiasm.” \n– Winston Churchill
“The best way to predict your future is to create it.” \n– Abraham Lincoln
“Successful people are not gifted; they just work hard, then succeed on purpose.” \n– G.K. Nielson
“Don’t watch the clock; do what it does. Keep going.” \n– Sam Levenson
“Work until your rivals become idols.” \n– Drake
“You can’t have a million-dollar dream on a minimum wage work ethic.” \n– Unknown
“You must do the kind of things you think you cannot do.” \n– Eleanor Roosevelt
“It’s not what you do once in a while it’s what you do day in and day out that makes the difference.” \n– Jenny Craig
“Falling down is how we grow. Staying down is how we die.” \n– Brian Vaszily
“Wealth isn’t about having a lot of money it’s about having a lot of options.” \n– Chris Rock
